steps.message:
My test script had a bug. `"<html>" < html.find("<head>")` is comparing a string to an integer.
I meant `html.find("<html>") < html.find("<head>")`.

Let's fix the test script.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from rich.console import Console
console = Console(record=True)
console.print("Hello World")
html = console.export_html()
print(html)
assert html.find("<!DOCTYPE html>") < html.find("<html>")
assert html.find("<html>") < html.find("<head>")
assert html.find("</head>") < html.find("<body>")
assert html.find("</body>") < html.find("</html>")
EOF
